title: Conquest ambience beds, positional emitters, artillery and flag cues
format: Ogg Opus 48 kHz via libopus (-fflags +bitexact); mono 96 kbit/s, stereo beds 128 kbit/s
licensePolicy: CC0 1.0, CC BY 3.0/4.0, U.S. federal government works (YouTube CC BY field verified with yt-dlp) and project-original synthesis only. CC BY credits: docs/audio/conquest-sfx.md and LICENSES.md.
notes: Freesound items are the public HQ previews (Ogg Vorbis) because original downloads need a login. The download_sha256 is the hash of that retrieved file. Build recipes: .conquest-work/wip/sfx/work-*/ (local).
